changelog:
- Initial release of the grid-health skill.
- Provides real-time grid bot health metrics: fill rate, inventory, and level status across trading pairs.
- Supports live monitoring for bots trading on Kraken, Coinbase Advanced Trade, and Hyperliquid.
- Easy access via x402-authenticated GET requests; no account or API key required—just an EVM wallet with USDC on Base.
- Includes transparent, tiered pricing with automatic early adopter discounts.
summary: Monitors real-time grid bot performance including fill rate, inventory levels, and status across trading pairs on multiple exchanges.
